hypotheses.title: Subindustry Foreign Currency Translation Efficiency and Short-Term Price Reversion Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Multinational companies reporting higher gains on foreign currency transactions and tax translation adjustments (fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_a) normalized by total assets possess superior treasury risk management and currency hedging capabilities. Applying a quadratic power transform isolates top hedging-efficient balance sheets within each subindustry, while a 15% 3-day short-term price reversal overlay harvests agile microstructure mean reversion, yielding superior risk-adjusted returns and robust sub-universe performance.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if foreign exchange translation gains stem entirely from unhedged speculative currency swings rather than disciplined risk management.

candidates.rationale: Variation 3 (8/8 PASS): Point-in-time asset-normalized FX translation gain with 15% 3-day delta reversal stabilizer
Variation 2 (8/8 PASS): 1-year trailing mean asset-normalized FX translation gain with 15% 3-day delta reversal stabilizer
